description: British Columbia Regional Flood Frequency Analysis Web Application is a dataset listed in British Columbia data catalogue (BC Data Catalogue), an open data portal, published or maintained by Water Management. This ArcGIS Online application displays the hydrometric stations and accompanying drainage areas analyzed as part of Bulletin 2020-1-RFFA described below. Coverage: British Columbia. The portal files it under the publisher Water Management. Its tags are ArcGIS Online, Flood, Frequenct, Hydrometric, Regional. It offers 4 resource(s) in CSV, OTHER, ZIP. The portal shows 2025-07-30 as the last update. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is Open Government Licence - British Columbia. Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support natural hazard exposure and risk studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-am-bc-portal.
